items.title: Sevdiğin yemekler
items.situation: A friend wants to cook something for you. Talk about the food you like and do not like.
items.situationTr: Bir arkadaşın sana bir şeyler pişirmek istiyor. Sevdiğin ve sevmediğin yemeklerden bahset.
prompts: Say what food you like.
Say what you do not like.
Say what you eat for breakfast.
Say what you can cook.

usefulPhrases.en: I like chicken and vegetables.
I do not like fish very much.
For breakfast I eat bread, cheese and eggs.
usefulPhrases.tr: Kahvaltıda ekmek, peynir ve yumurta yiyorum.

usefulPhrases.en: I can cook rice and soup.
I drink tea in the morning.

items.title: Bir arkadaşı aramak
items.situation: You call a friend but his mother answers the phone. Say who you are and leave a message.
items.situationTr: Bir arkadaşını arıyorsun ama telefona annesi çıkıyor. Kim olduğunu söyle ve mesaj bırak.
prompts: Say hello and say who you are.
Ask for your friend.
Ask when he comes home.
Leave a short message.
promptsTr: Merhaba de ve kim olduğunu söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: Hello, this is Kaan.
Is Murat at home?
When does he come home?
Can you tell him I called?
I will call again in the evening.

items.title: Anahtarımı kaybettim
items.situation: You cannot find your key. You are in front of your building. Talk to your neighbor.
items.situationTr: Anahtarını bulamıyorsun. Binanın önündesin. Komşunla konuş.
prompts: Say what the problem is.
Say where you were today.
Ask your neighbor for help.
Say what you will do now.

usefulPhrases.en: I cannot find my key.
I was at school and then at the shop.
Can you help me, please?
My sister has the other key.
I will wait here for an hour.

items.title: Boş zamanında ne yaparsın
items.situation: You meet a new person in a language class. Talk about what you do in your free time.
items.situationTr: Bir dil kursunda yeni biriyle tanışıyorsun. Boş zamanında ne yaptığını anlat.
prompts: Say what you do after work or school.
Say what you do on Sundays.
Say who you do it with.
Ask her about her free time.
promptsTr: İşten ya da okuldan sonra ne yaptığını söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: After work I watch television.
On Sundays I play football with my friends.
I like reading books at home.
My sister comes with me.
What do you do in your free time?

items.title: Yarın için plan
items.situation: You want to go out with a friend tomorrow. Make a plan with him.
items.situationTr: Yarın bir arkadaşınla dışarı çıkmak istiyorsun. Onunla plan yap.
prompts: Ask if he is free tomorrow.
Say what you want to do.
Say a time and a place.
Say what he must bring.
promptsTr: Bir saat ve bir yer söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: Are you free tomorrow?
Let us go to the park.
We can meet at two in front of the school.
Please bring some water.
If it rains, we can go to the cinema.
